name: Homesfy Realty Ltd.
summary: Homesfy Realty Ltd. is an Indian real estate brokerage and advisory company primarily focused on the residential sector. The company provides end-to-end real estate services, including property search, advisory, and transaction facilitation, for retail buyers and real estate developers. It assists developers in selling new constructed properties and aids potential customers in purchasing them. Homesfy Realty operates on an asset-light, commission-based business model, generating revenue from brokerage fees paid by developers for successful sales. The company utilizes a tech-enabled platform for its operations, including CRM and lead management, and also offers financial services such as secured and unsecured loans in collaboration with various banks. Its target markets include major Indian real estate hubs like Mumbai, Pune, Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR, and Hyderabad, with an expanded presence in Dubai.
